title: Visa requirement (reference, cross-check only)
description: One record: the entry requirement for holders of one passport visiting one destination, as a reference work (Wikipedia) summarises it. NOT an official rule: used only to cross-check `visa_rule` records and flag disagreements; never shown as the answer. Voyager use: visa (cross-check).

destination_country.description: The destination as the table names it, in English.

destination_country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 of `destination_country`, when it is a country the table names unambiguously.

requirement.description: The requirement, from the table's own wording.

requirement_text.description: The table's requirement cell as written (markup removed).

max_stay_days.description: Allowed stay in days, only when the table states it in days or weeks (months are left in `allowed_stay_text`).

allowed_stay_text.description: The table's allowed-stay cell as written (markup removed).

notes.description: The table's notes cell, markup and references removed.

article_title.description: The Wikipedia article the row comes from.

revision_id.description: The article revision the row was read from.

provenance.description: Where the row comes from: a reference work, never an official source.

source_url.description: The page's own link for this item (official site, booking or detail page), copied verbatim from the page.

as_of.description: The "last updated", "valid from" or publication date the page itself states for this information (YYYY-MM-DD).

items.description: A verbatim quote from the page.

evidence.description: Up to 3 short verbatim quotes from the page that support the most important facts.
